镜头 s19：纪录片现场纪实镜头，时长 11 秒，16:9 横屏，24fps，单镜头一镜到底（只写 [Shot 1]）。
风格模式：固定风格（style preset sp01-arch58）。锁定外观 / Locked look（detailed_description 第一行必须照此书写，并逐字包含 ['ENG broadcast camera', 'scan lines']）：Locked look "2058 broadcast news archive" (style preset sp01-arch58): a shoulder-mounted 2/3-inch ENG broadcast camera; broadcast tape, later dubbed; an 18x broadcast zoom at auto iris; filter none; grade: hot clipped whites, crushed murky shadows, chroma smear on reds; light: floodlights, emergency strobes and whatever is there; texture: interlaced softness, faint scan lines, compression noise, an occasional tape dropout; urgent news footage of a disaster operation, the operator running with the crew.
该类型的纪录片默认机位：fly-on-the-wall documentary camera, shoulder-mounted handheld with small reframings, operator reacting late
导演意图（自然语言）：手持中景，镜头在两人之间。探照灯下，穿潜水服的宋工把那只铁盒塞到波爷手里，交代了一句；波爷攥着盒子回了一句。宋工笑了笑，转身走向水边。环境声：水泵轰鸣、远处的喊声、水声。
情绪：tender, resolute, foreboding
建议的景别与运镜（只做一个主要运镜）：medium two-shot, handheld documentary camera between them with a gentle sway
景深与虚实：Faces sharp, floodlights behind them blooming into soft flares.
输入图片（按发送顺序；Subject N 对应 Picture N）：
Picture 1: the storyboard keyframe of this shot (opening frame). It shows: Handheld documentary medium shot at the floodlit staging area by the black water in 2058: Song, 43, grey at the temples, in a black diving suit with a helmet under his arm, presses the dented tin box with its antenna into the hands of Boye, 44, in black-framed glasses and a navy quilted jacket; floodlights glare behind them. Blocking lock: Song in the black diving suit stands at frame left, Boye at frame right; the tin box passes between their hands at frame centre; floodlights and black water in the background.
Picture 2: Engineer Song at 43 (2058, the restart operation) (character reference; role: the protagonist). The same man ten years later, 43: the same face, mole and thin round steel-rimmed glasses, now grey at the temples, short stubble, a thinner face with deeper lines and tired eyes. Dark olive engineering field jacket with reflective strips over a black thermal undersuit.
Picture 3: Song's prototype node (the dented tin box, still without a sticker) (prop reference; role: prop reference). A handmade prototype network node: an old dented steel tin box with a plain scratched olive-grey lid, a salvaged circuit board, a small heat sink, three tiny LEDs and a short screw-on antenna, on a cluttered lab workbench under a desk lamp. No sticker on the lid.
Picture 4: the staging area of the 2058 root-server restart operation (location reference; role: location reference). A staging area at the edge of a flooded underground root-server facility in 2058: floodlights on tripods glaring off black water that covers the floor, concrete pillars, coils of cable, open equipment cases, diving helmets and air tanks on a tarp, a temporary railing at the water's edge. Empty of people, urgent, cold.
台词（逐字照抄，按顺序，每句放进一个 <d>[Chinese] ...</d>）：
1. Song (a man in his early forties, warm, steady, slightly hoarse voice) — 宋工（四十出头男性的声音，温和坚定，略沙哑）: 替我收着。万一哪天用得上。
2. Boye at forty-four (male voice, brisk, slightly gruff and stubborn) — 四十四岁的波爷（男声，干脆、略带倔强）: 你自己回来拿。
现场环境声：roaring water pumps, distant shouting, lapping water
参考词汇（检索所得，只借用术语与思路，不要整段照抄，不得改变锁定外观）：
[rules/move/documentary-handheld] move
[rules/lens/documentary-zoom] lens
[ours/cam-verite-follow] 机位：纪实手持跟拍
[ours/pace-doc] 节奏：纪录片的呼吸
[ours/tex-flooded] 被淹的机房与集结区
画面中没有字幕、文字、数字和水印；没有任何音乐和旁白；只说普通话。
